content.title: About
content.content: The frozen mocha coffee drink, nonfat, is a refreshing cold beverage made from coffee, cocoa and low‑fat milk. It blends aromatic espresso, smooth chocolate flavor and a light creamy texture without added cream.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink is produced by rapid freezing, which locks in the coffee and chocolate aromas.
The nonfat version contains roughly half the calories of a traditional mocha coffee.
It often uses a natural sweetener such as stevia to reduce sugar content.
Mocha combines two popular flavors—coffee and chocolate—making it a favorite for those who enjoy both bitter and sweet notes.
The frozen format allows serving without extra ice, preserving a uniform texture.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Coffee and cocoa are rich in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, enhancing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: The nonfat version contains less than 0.5 g of fat per serving, suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Calcium provision
items.content: The milk base supplies calcium essential for bone health.

items.title: Mood improvement
items.content: Chocolate components promote serotonin production, helping improve mood.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Individuals sensitive to caffeine should limit intake to avoid anxiety or insomnia.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Low‑fat milk may trigger reactions in people allergic to lactose or casein.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Despite lower calories, the drink may contain added sugar or sweeteners, which is important for diabetics to monitor.

items.title: Cold shock
items.content: Rapid freezing can create small ice crystals; those with sensitive teeth should consume cautiously.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the frozen mocha coffee with a spoon or straw as a refreshing treat. Optional additions include a pinch of cinnamon or a dash of vanilla extract for flavor variation.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the freezer at –18 °C. After opening, consume within 2–3 days to maintain texture and flavor.
